data.narrative:
Jimmy Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Antoine Guyot and Mathilde Grivet that has raised €80M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 companies across the nuclear energy sector—3 public entities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, Helion, Fuse Energy, and X-Energy, spanning seed through Series B stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the €80M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A-to-next-stage progression, yielding €160M. Peer-Median triangulates across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Valar Atomics (Series B, $6.0B), Nano Nuclear Energy (Seed, $808M), and Fuse Energy (Series A, $200M)—producing a median valuation of $808M, with a range of $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $136M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $484M. The wide range reflects meaningful dispersion in peer valuations and inherent uncertainty around stage-appropriate multiples in a nascent, capital-intensive sector. Key drivers of variance include technology readiness, regulatory pathway clarity, and capital requirements to reach commercial deployment. The median of $484M represents a reasonable central estimate pending deeper diligence on Jimmy Energy's technical position relative to the peer set.
